title: What strategies are used to address problematic behaviours in children with autism at Pinnacle Blooms?
metaTitle: Addressing Problematic Behaviors in Children with Autism - ABA Therapy at Pinnacle Blooms
description: Discover how Pinnacle Blooms uses ABA therapy to address problematic behaviors in children with autism. Learn about positive reinforcement and individualized strategies for managing challenging behaviors.
html: Pinnacle Blooms employs strategies such as ABA to address problematic behaviours. This approach uses positive reinforcement to increase desirable behaviors and diminish the ones that are harmful or affect learning. Individualised strategies are developed based on the child’s behavioural assessment.
